purpose: Teach: ６つ/ミソ/外野/ヤミ/タネ/キズ/オジサン/くず

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが６つの種類の花を植えて下さるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to plant six different kinds of flowers for us.
lines.style: Warm, gentle introduction. Soft opening. Slight lift of affection on 'Dad.' Unhurried pace, like she's sharing something tender. Voice settles at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとミソ漬けを作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I made miso pickles together.
lines.style: Bright, quick energy on the opening. Small boy pride in the accomplishment. Words tumble a little — excitement barely contained. Innocent eagerness without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「外野でも応援できる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said we can cheer even from the sidelines.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle tone, like she's translating something important she just realized. Slight wonder underneath. Soft, attentive delivery — this matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ヤミに落ちない」物語を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a story about never falling into darkness.
lines.style: Quiet certainty in the voice. Small but steady. He's sharing something he understood. No performance — just simple, genuine recounting. Slight solemnity, age-appropriate gravity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが朝顔のタネを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad gave me morning glory seeds.
lines.style: Soft delight in the delivery. Gentle opening on his name. Slight warmth on 'gave' — the intimacy of a small gift. Unhurried, savoring the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに膝のキズを手当てして頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad helped me clean and bandage a cut on my knee.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact opening, then warmth creeps in. He's remembering the care underneath the practical act. Small child trust in every word. Quiet gratitude without needing to say it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「オジサンも面白い」って笑って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad laughed and said even uncles can be interesting.
lines.style: Soft amusement in her voice. Slight lift of a smile on 'laughed.' The gentle observation of someone watching someone she loves enjoy himself. Warm, unhurried, slightly mischievous.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「くず葉も大事」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that even broken leaves still matter.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the lesson. Slow delivery — this is something he's turning over in his mind. Child-wisdom meeting adult-wisdom. Soft close, like a door gently closing on something understood.
